published_date_note: Official Jingdezhen China Ceramics Museum reservation notice dated March 31, 2026.
claim: The official museum notice states that the museum opens Tuesday–Sunday, stops entry at 16:30 and closes at 17:00, with Monday closure except statutory holidays; it also says the sole official reservation channel is the Changyou Jingdezhen WeChat mini-program and that individual visitors may reserve up to five days ahead when quota exists.
notes: Foreign visitors' identity and payment path must be tested separately; do not recommend third-party reservation sellers.
